name: MY LIFE WITH ROBLOX 2026 × Musinsa
tagline: Roblox's blocky world rebuilt as Seongsu streetwear
description: Musinsa turned four of its Seongsu stores into a Roblox playground for three weeks. The main Megastore space recreates everyday Korean hangouts — a study room, a subway car, a convenience store and a PC bang — as walk-through sets built in Roblox's blocky style. The limited collection puts three of the platform's biggest game worlds onto graphic tees and character goods, sold only while the pop-up runs.

name: Evangelion 30th Anniversary Fair
tagline: Three decades of Eva, celebrated in Hongdae
description: Animate's Hongdae branch marks Evangelion's 30th anniversary with a merchandise fair running into early September. Expect the anniversary goods line alongside the shop's standing Evangelion range, with a collectible phone-card-style sticker given out at random when you buy or pre-order a series item. An easy stop if you are already circling the Hongik University station shops.

name: Pompompurin Bakery Cafe
tagline: Sanrio's pudding-loving retriever runs a bakery counter
description: Sanrio's beret-wearing golden retriever gets his own bakery counter on the Sweet Park pop-up stage, in the basement food hall of Shinsegae's Gangnam store. Expect breads and desserts shaped after the character plus limited merchandise that only exists for the run. The food floor connects straight into Express Bus Terminal station, so it is an easy detour rather than a trip out.
